title: Congestion pricing had an estimated effect of −4.2% on trips touching the zone

subtitles.effects: By mode, the estimated effect on trips touching the zone was −8.1% for ride-hail apps and −7.8% for yellow cabs; green cabs, 0.2% of NYC trips, came out at +4.1%
subtitles.weekly_effect: Weekly estimated effects on trips touching the zone ran from −7.4% to −0.9% (10th to 90th percentile of weeks)
subtitles.weekly_trips: In 2025, trips touching the zone rose 1.7% on the same weeks of 2024, while trips elsewhere rose 6.1%
subtitles.fees: Trips were charged $246.8 million in congestion fees from Jan 2025 to Aug 2026; Uber trips paid the most, 60% of it
subtitles.zone_change: Pickups per day fell in 19 of 260 zones from 2024 to 2025, including 11 of the 38 in the congestion zone

excluded_weeks.reason: Martin Luther King Jr. Day is in ISO week 3 in 2024 (Mon 15 Jan) and week 4 in 2025 (Mon 20 Jan)
